 Follow ‘General Hospital’s’ Laura Wright is ‘Thrilled’ About This Incredible Family Milestone
 Hope Campbell Wed, October 21, 2026 at 12:28 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. KH1 / WENN.com / MEGA General Hospital star Laura Wright is going to have a groom in the family soon. The longtime soap star took to Instagram on Tuesday afternoon to share the news of her son John's engagement.
 "My favorite son is getting hitched and we are thrilled!!! We love you both so so much!!!" Wright wrote on Instagram , alongside a photo of her son and his fiancée showing her stunning engagement ring.
 Wright's current GH leading man, James Patrick Stuart (Valentin Cassadine), offered his congratulations, writing, "Just wonderful. Congratulations to them both!!! Xoxox."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Her former leading man, Cameron Mathison (Drew Cain), left heart emojis while Kayden Brenna Tokarski wrote, "Aww, big congratulations!!"
 Wright shares two children with ex-husband John Wright : daughter Lauren, 27, and son John (LJ), 25. She has been dating former GH star Wes Ramsey (ex-Peter August) since 2017, according to Soap Opera Digest .
 On Mother's Day of this year, Wright revealed the movie she and her son used to watch together when he was a small boy in an Instagram pos t.
 "LJ and Lala – I soooo love being your mom !!!!! Yep, I picked this song because LJ and I used to watch Tarzan together all the time when he was little and I loved it!!!" she wrote, next to a carousel of herself and her children through the years.
 Advertisement Advertisement On-screen, Wright's Carly likely doesn't have any weddings to look forward to soon, as none of her adult kids appear to be headed toward the altar, but perhaps Carly will end up walking down the aisle sooner rather than later as her romance with Valentin is reaching new heights.
